speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) how are feedback and requests from the public, medical professionals, and Members of Parliament weighted when considering whether a condition should be included in the Chronic Disease Management Programme (CDMP) to be eligible for treatment subsidies; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider creating an additional category to subsidise treatment costs of non-CDMP conditions such as glaucoma which if left untreated can impair the Instrumental Activities of Daily Living of senior persons.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: No Singaporean will be denied access to appropriate healthcare due to an inability to pay.

speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
text: And that it is imperative to help elderly residents be able to manage this condition which affect their mobility and independence of living much more upstream.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The CAC meets quite regularly, and they do review different conditions over time.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, I think this will be a continuing effort on our part to look at all the different data and information to see what are the other conditions that can be included.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The Member raised a point about looking ahead and considering how some of these conditions will impact people.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Indeed, this is the thinking behind how we review the conditions that are included under CDMP because we do look at the disease burden and how the complications can arise if there is no early intervention.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We look at the availability of evidence-based clinical guidelines for the appropriate care.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, these are all things that we do consider.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: In fact, we take into account some of the downstream effect if some efforts are not taken in to put in place.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: In fact, her inputs are useful because, as I mentioned earlier, even inputs from the Members of Parliament are also taken into account as we review the subsidies under all our different frameworks as well as CDMP.
